BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-12 commit 067d933. 25 content files + 8 ADRs. Methodology v1.2. STAGES DONE THROUGH 17 (complete, sections 1-40). Stage 16.5 inserted (00r-what-is-a-covenant.md).

ALWAYS READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. v1.2 added COVENANTAL JURISDICTION, MEANING-ATTACHED-TO-ACTION, CORRECTED INSTITUTION-TRACING MODEL, and the COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE as rule 5.

STAGE 17 COMPLETE (00q, sections 1-40). Second half:
- Ezekiel labeled correctly: Deut 30:6 -> Ezek 36:26-27 -> Rom 2:29 = INTERTEXTUAL THEOLOGICAL TRAJECTORY, NOT direct quotation. Ezekiel doesn't use 'circumcision of the heart' and we don't make him.
- COLOSSIANS 2:11 acheiropoietos ('not made with hands') — Paul says something happened that HE CALLS circumcision, links it to burial/resurrection in immersion (2:12). RESTRAINT: do NOT conclude 'baptism replaced circumcision'. Proximity != one-for-one replacement. Secondary inference requiring its own case, NOT made.
- Acts 8 eunuch: handled explicitly as ARGUMENT FROM SILENCE. Immersion recorded, circumcision unmentioned. Tier B inference only; absence of mention != evidence of absence. Note Luke shows practice BEFORE the argument about it.
- ACTS 10: Ruach -> immersion, NOT circumcision -> admission -> Ruach. Circumcised believers 'AMAZED'. Peter in Acts 15 isn't arguing from principle, he's REPORTING what Yahweh did before witnesses.
- EXODUS 12:48 CONTROL CASE (makes Acts 15 LARGER not smaller): Torah already provided a mechanism for deep foreign participation (Passover) WITH physical circumcision as part of it — 'he shall be as a native of the land'. THE STRONGER EXODUS 12:48 IS, THE MORE SIGNIFICANT ACTS 15 BECOMES. No need to minimize the earlier command; THE SURPRISE IS THE EVIDENCE.
- RUTH CONTROL: 'your people shall be my people' (1:16), fully incorporated, enters David's genealogy and therefore Messiah's — AND SCRIPTURE KEEPS CALLING HER 'RUTH THE MOABITE' (2:2; CJB 'Rut the woman from Mo'av'). INCORPORATION DOES NOT REQUIRE ERASURE OF ORIGIN.
- 'MESSIANIC ISRAELITE' NOW DEFINED (second disciplining; first was Stage 5). In 01-convictions B.5: 'I use Messianic Israelite to describe my understanding that through Yeshua HaMashiach I have been brought near to the covenants of promise and grafted into the covenant people whose story Scripture traces through Israel — while recognizing that this does not make me ethnically descended from Jacob.' NOT biological descent, NOT Gentiles replacing ethnic Israel. Ruth is what makes it coherent rather than defensive. Prevents reproducing replacement theology while trying to reject it. Stronger case = Rom 11 / Eph 2:12,19 / Gal 3:29 — NOT Romans 2.
- GAL 3:29 'heirs ACCORDING TO PROMISE' — not 'Gentiles become physical descendants via circumcision', almost the opposite. Requiring circumcision would relocate covenantal status from Messiah+faith back to a physical boundary marker: not merely unnecessary, IT WOULD CONTRADICT THE MECHANISM.

TWO NEW RULES:
1. COVENANTAL JURISDICTION (possibly the most portable discovery): who received it / under what covenant / for what purpose / what scope (universal, national, priestly, familial, individual, temporary, typological) / what does later Scripture do with it (reaffirm, transform administration, expand, narrow, identify fulfillment). 'YAHWEH COMMANDED X SOMEWHERE' != 'YAHWEH COMMANDS X OF EVERY BELIEVER FOREVER' — AND — 'IT WASN'T ADDRESSED TO ME' != 'IT CONTAINS NOTHING FOR ME'. Both shortcuts avoid exegesis: one by discarding, one by flattening. Scripture supplies the principle abundantly (ark to Noah, Isaac to Abraham, priestly obligations, Nazirites, kings). EXTENDS the Eleven-Question Protocol: Protocol asks what happened to a command, Jurisdiction asks who it was ever addressed to.
2. MEANING-ATTACHED-TO-ACTION: Timothy circumcised (Acts 16:3), Titus's circumcision refused (Gal 2:3-5). SAME PHYSICAL ACTION, DIFFERENT COVENANTAL CLAIM ATTACHED. Therefore biblical actions can't always be classified morally without examining the claim attached in context. Same shape as Acts 10 (people not menus) and Hebrews 'once for all' (necessary sin offerings specifically) — THE OBJECT OF THE CLAIM DETERMINES THE CLAIM.

MODEL FORMALLY CORRECTED: Stage 16 tempted 'Old MOSAIC shadow -> Messiah reality'. CIRCUMCISION BREAKS IT by predating Sinai. NEW MODEL: trace each institution from its EARLIEST biblical appearance -> covenantal function -> prophetic development -> Yeshua -> apostolic interpretation -> continuity/transformation from the whole trajectory. IMMEDIATE COST ACCEPTED AS EVIDENCE IT'S REAL: the food investigation CANNOT BEGIN AT LEVITICUS.

MATT 5:17 NOW CONSTRAINED FROM BOTH SIDES: 'fulfill' can't secretly mean abolish (katalyo explicitly negated); 'not abolish' can't mean every administration continues identically (Hebrews made that impossible for priesthood/sacrifice; CIRCUMCISION NOW MAKES IT IMPOSSIBLE FROM A SECOND INDEPENDENT DIRECTION). Two institutions investigated separately, converging on one constraint.

NEXT — STAGE 18: CLEAN AND UNCLEAN FOOD. Sequence to follow: Genesis 7-9 -> Leviticus 11 -> Deuteronomy 14 -> Prophets -> Yeshua/Mark 7 -> Acts 10 -> Acts 15 -> Romans 14 -> 1 Corinthians 8-10 -> Colossians 2 -> 1 Timothy 4. NEITHER ASSUMPTION PERMITTED: not 'Torah dietary distinctions obviously continue unchanged', not 'Yeshua declared everything edible, end of discussion'. ALREADY ESTABLISHED AND CARRIED IN: Gen 7:2 puts clean/unclean BEFORE Sinai (so 'merely Mosaic' fails a second consecutive stage) BUT Gen 8:20 shows the FIRST EXPLICIT NARRATIVE USE IS SACRIFICIAL NOT DIETARY — predating Sinai does NOT establish identical meaning/purpose/scope (Anti-Replacement applied at the moment of discovery). ACTS 10:14 RECORDED IN ADVANCE so it can't be stepped over later: 'I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean' — spoken YEARS AFTER Yeshua's ministry by the apostle who was there. THAT SENTENCE HAS TO BE ALLOWED TO MEAN SOMETHING. Both halves carried: it establishes what PETER understood at that moment; it does not by itself settle what the apostolic writings require of Gentiles. Acts 10:28 already established Peter's own stated interpretation concerns PEOPLE.

LARGER QUESTION NOW VISIBLE, carried deliberately, not yet answered: if BOTH circumcision AND clean/unclean predate Sinai, how much of what is casually called 'the Mosaic Law' originates there at all?

COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

Vault standard is Yeshua HaMashiach (not YahuShua) — user is aware of/has used the YahuShua transliteration but explicitly decided 2026-08-08 to keep Yeshua as the vault's standing term. Do not silently switch if it comes up again — this was a deliberate choice, not an oversight.
